thread:
riley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: yesterday's schema migration caused the metering job to emit records to both old_topic and new_topic for ~2 hours. That produced a ledger gap + some duplicated token rows once the consumer reprocessed new_topic. Need owners for reconciliation, credits, and a permanent migration-safe check.

priya: I can own the migration-safe check. Plan: add a migration-mode flag that prevents dual-write, and a preflight that verifies lag=0 before cutover. ETA Thu EOD (2026-04-07).

tom-o: i'll handle reconciliation automation. i'll write a job to diff account_token_totals between snapshots and generate a corrections CSV. ETA Wed (2026-04-06).

ellie-fin: finance needs the CSV with columns: invoice_id, account_id, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, suggested_credit_usd, reason_code. Please tag me when ready.

billing-bot: Ticket MET-6001 created: "Migration dual-write causing ledger duplicates and delayed invoices" assignees: priya,tom-o due: 2026-04-10

riley: quick query tom might use to surface suspicious accounts:

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_count) as tokens, COUNT(*) as rows
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE inserted_at >= '2026-04-01' AND source IN ('metering-consumer','migration-proxy')
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 OR SUM(token_count) > 50000
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

priya: i'll also add an alert: if the migration proxy writes to >1 topic for more than 5m, send a P1 to #eng-oncall.

tom-o: ack. starting the reconciliation job and will post results to MET-6001.

ellie-fin: ack. will review CSV and approve credits for amounts < $200 automatically, escalate others.

riley: action summary: priya - migration-safe flag + preflight (ETA 2026-04-07); tom-o - reconciliation job + corrections CSV (ETA 2026-04-06); ellie-fin - credit approval criteria & sign-off (ETA 2026-04-06). Update MET-6001 with links.

priya: ack. I'll include a rollback checklist for the migration switch.

billing-bot: Reminder: MET-6001 follow-up meeting scheduled Fri 09:00.

riley: thanks everyone. please keep customer comms staged with ellie-fin so we don't double-notify. :wave:
